text:
Ravi: deploy-bot paused promo for release 2026.03.22 due to blue-integration matrix failures across multiple shards. holding cut.
Noor: ugh, paste the failing job logs?
Ravi: from job ci/matrix/integration/shard-5:
```
RUN TESTS: python -m pytest tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py -k 'eviction'
EPOCH 1/3: started
AssertionError: expected 3 keys in cache, got 1
Captured stderr:
  WARNING: Connection reset by peer (redis-proxy)

ci-bot: Flaky test detector: shard-5 failure pattern matches recent flake signature 'redis-proxy-reset-2026-03'. Occurred 4 times in last 2 hours across different SHAs.
```
Tess: if flake detector recognizes a known intermittent failure, we typically either: 1) rerun only affected shards (fast), 2) pin to last-green SHA for this release, or 3) skip test temporarily and proceed. Which is preferred?
Noor: what's the risk surface for pinning? This build includes a small perf bump and updated dependency on grpc. Pinning to last-green will skip that change.
Ravi: product requested this feature to land today, but not under a strict customer SLA. We can wait up to 2 hours.
Tess: rerunning the failing shards is low risk. However the flake detector said it matches a redis-proxy network reset pattern tied to a canary infra job that was restarted. If infrastructure is unstable, reruns may keep failing.
Noor: ops team, any infra noise?
ci-bot: No active infra incidents. However, test-redis-proxy in the CI pool had a rolling restart at 02:14 UTC today. Close in time to the failures.
Ravi: options: A) re-run shard-5 and nearby shards now (fast). B) pin release to last-green commit and schedule a follow-up PR for grpc upgrade. C) delay promo until we root-cause the redis-proxy restarts.
Tess: given product wants the feature and we have 2 hours, I propose we rerun the failing shards with isolation (spawn new ephemeral redis-proxy instance for that run). If they pass, proceed. If they fail again, fallback to pin B. Also add a short note in the release notes about the delayed grpc upgrade.
Noor: agree. How do we instruct deploy-bot to rerun only shards?
Ravi: use `deploy-bot rerun-ci --job ci/matrix/integration --shards 4-6 --isolated-redis`. I'll run it.
deploy-bot: Received manual command from Ravi. Queuing reruns for shards 4,5,6 with isolated redis instances.
Tess: monitoring logs. If we get >1 failure across the reruns, we should pin.
Ravi: rerun results: shard-4 PASS, shard-5 PASS, shard-6 PASS. All green.
ci-bot: integration matrix now green for commit sha256:bbcc...88.
Ravi: resuming promotion. deploy-bot: promotion resumed by Ravi. Verifying artifact and checksum... OK.
Noor: nice. Please add a follow-up ticket to investigate redis-proxy stability in CI and add a guard to promotion flow to auto-isolate flaky infra tests in future.
Tess: open ticket ENGINFRA-2121 and assign to infra. Also tag QA to add a non-flaky variant of the eviction test that doesn't depend on proxy restarts.
Ravi: release cut succeeded. Updating release notes with a small note: "grpc dependency upgrade deferred due to CI flake; core feature included."
Noor: thanks everyone. Closing thread. :shipit:
